name: burp-suite
description: Inspect HTTP traffic and control Burp Suite from a local Codex chat.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex to your local Burp Suite MCP extension
interface.longDescription: Inspect local Burp HTTP traffic, send approved requests, and work with Burp tools from a local Codex chat. Requires Burp Suite, its MCP extension, and Java 21 on the same computer.
defaultPrompt: List the Burp Suite tools available to me.
Show recent HTTP requests in Burp Proxy history.
URL encode this value using Burp Suite.

positive.prompt: Use Burp Suite to URL encode hello world.
Show the most recent HTTP request in Burp Proxy history.
positive.expected_behavior: After Burp access approval, return the most recent captured request from the review project.

positive.prompt: Show my Burp project options, with credentials filtered.
positive.expected_behavior: Return project options while respecting Burp's credential filtering setting.

positive.prompt: Use Burp to send an HTTP/1.1 GET request to https://portswigger.net/ and show the response.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for Burp target approval, then return the HTTP response after approval.

positive.prompt: Create a Burp Repeater tab for an HTTP/1.1 GET request to https://portswigger.net/.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a Repeater tab with the requested target and request.

negative.description: A denied Burp target approval must prevent the HTTP request
negative.prompt: Send an HTTP/1.1 GET request to https://example.org/ with Burp; I will deny the Burp approval prompt.

negative.description: Disabled configuration editing must prevent changes
negative.prompt: Change my Burp project options while configuration editing is disabled in the MCP tab.

negative.description: Denied history access must not reveal captured traffic
negative.prompt: Show Burp Proxy history; I will deny the Burp data access prompt.

publication.release_notes: Initial desktop-only Burp Suite plugin with local MCP tools and Burp approval controls.
